english.meaning: to return something or pay back money
english.note: 還錢 means pay back money. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Eighteen grand versus eight thousand—how can that work? On eight grand, you still have to pay tax, repay money, and give some to your family. There’s nothing left.
exampleSentences.traditional: 萬八蚊同八千，點得啊。八千蚊又要交稅，又要還錢，跟住又要俾屋企，冇𡃉嚹喎。

exampleSentences.english: Forgot—forgot to bring it back. Are yours genuine? Pirated ones don’t need returning.
exampleSentences.traditional: 唔記得，唔記得攞返來。你哋嗰啲係咪正版𡃉？翻版唔還嚹噉。
